question: In Spring 2025, do 67-272 (Mon/Wed 08:30–09:45) and 67-373 (Monday 14:30–15:45) have a schedule conflict?
expected_answer: No — both courses meet on Monday, but at different times: 67-272 is 08:30–09:45 and 67-373 is 14:30–15:45. There is a 4+ hour gap between them on Mondays, and 67-272 also meets Wednesday while 67-373 does not. A student could enroll in both without a scheduling conflict.
common_mistake: Seeing that both courses meet on Monday and assuming a conflict without checking actual times; not recognizing that Monday meetings at 08:30 and 14:30 do not overlap
needs_verification: Confirm 67-373 has no additional meeting times (e.g., labs or recitations) that might conflict
